airoute.t01: A local model is too heavy for this device — the tools run without AI
airoute.t02: It runs inside the device (you chose not to send anything out)
airoute.t03: To run it inside the device, the model has to be fetched once
airoute.t04: It calls out with your key (fast, better quality)
airoute.t05: It runs inside the device with the model you already have (no key needed)
airoute.t06: It works without a key — you only fetch the model once
airoute.t07: AI features are unavailable right now — the tools still work
airoute.t08: This browser does not support WebGPU — the tools still work
airoute.t09: This is when the device’s graphics settings do not fit. Close other heavy tabs and try again.
airoute.noLocal: This browser cannot run a local AI{tail} — the tool itself still works
airoute.downloadCut: Fetching the model was cut off{tail} — fetch it again, or put in a key and use it remotely
airoute.stalled: It stalled while processing{tail} — trim the input a little and try again
airoute.downloadNote: {mb}MB is fetched once — at this speed, about {time}. After that it opens right away.
